title: Runtime Reliability & Data Truth
scope: Close verified remaining ADR-GDI gaps without rebuilding existing reliability controls.
Make DATA DEGRADED semantics capability-scoped and impact-oriented, with canonical reason taxonomy and explicit affected consumers.
Preserve truthful critical-data usability and require ABSTAIN/NO RELIABLE EDGE when required decision evidence is not trustworthy.
Add recovery hysteresis so one transient success cannot immediately clear a genuine degraded condition.
Audit and harden provider/capability health aggregation using the existing Provider Router and capability-state owners.
Prove dataset/session-aware freshness SLO behavior using the existing freshness and runtime SLO owners.
Audit and generalize duplicate-work suppression/single-flight only where verified gaps remain; retain the existing broad snapshot broker and canonical reuse path.
Audit bounded retries, capability circuits, request budgets, queue/backpressure and load shedding; strengthen only missing behavior.
Preserve source-disagreement truth through the existing provider reconciliation owner; no averaging or parallel reconciliation engine.
Run realistic deterministic/synthetic active-market pressure and latency qualification, with bounded live-provider smoke only when live behavior is the subject under test.
outOfScope: No new provider or external service.
No parallel provider router, freshness engine, reliability engine or decision engine.
No execution, paper trading, order routing, P&L, portfolio or journal features.
No broad renderer redesign or unrelated UI modularization.
No Stable publication until exact-head G0-G16 evidence supports a release-capable candidate.
permanentBoundaries: Smart Provider Router v2 is sole provider-routing authority
Deterministic Day/Swing/Long market truth remains protected
Adaptive reliability changes with production impact follow SHADOW -> VALIDATED -> APPROVED -> PRODUCTION
